text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, that takes me back! I still have
cards from that game at my parents' place too~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kawakami-san! You totally used to do this
when you were little too, right?
Collecting shiny cards, and—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! Could you possibly be talking about *that* game?!
I've been playing it too! Me too!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami & Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Fierce Battle: Insect Battle MAX!"!
"Dress-Up Fashion ★ Hearts & Diamonds"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...It was in that moment I truly realized:
"Finding like-minded comrades is no simple feat."
